cohort: Sixty parturients (ASA II, aged 18-40 years) scheduled for elective cesarean section.
finding: Hyperbaric ropivacaine 0.75% resulted in a slightly delayed onset but significantly shorter duration of both sensory and motor blockade compared to hyperbaric bupivacaine 0.5% for spinal anesthesia.
mod_finding: Hyperbaric ropivacaine 0.75% provides effective spinal anesthesia for cesarean section with a shorter duration of motor blockade, potentially facilitating earlier ambulation and discharge after birth.
